revised_claim_text: Automated data-sharing with supply chain partners is a widely-reported gap: only 60% of companies have comprehensive tier-1 supplier visibility (McKinsey 2024 SC Risk Survey, n=88); only 11% have near real-time disruption alerting (Accenture 2024, n=3,000+); 78% need ≥1 week to assess disruption impact (same source); 47% of operations leaders cite integration complexity as the chief barrier to technology ROI (PwC 2025). The specific Beacon survey figure ('44% lack automated data-sharing processes') is a vendor-published survey and is not independently corroborated.
footnote_for_artifact: Composite citation: McKinsey Supply Chain Risk Survey 2024 (mckinsey.com); Gartner press release Sep 2023; Accenture supply chain research 2024 (newsroom.accenture.com); PwC Digital Trends in Operations Survey 2025. Beacon's own 44% figure retained only as illustrative vendor data.
notes: 8 independent surveys checked; none publishes the narrow 'automated data-sharing process adoption' metric in Beacon's specific framing. Replace single-source claim with the composite finding from McKinsey/Accenture/PwC. Score stays Low for the Beacon specific figure, but the broader visibility-gap narrative is independently anchored.
